svg.text: MPx-SQ2-003 · Removable disc cassettes A / B / C
MPx Squeeze v2 (Mini) · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Disc enters the frame from below (clean side) against the 0.8 lip; laser seam-weld disc to frame all round on the clean side.
2. Fine (membrane) side faces UP = dirty side; engrave 'IN ↑' and the letter A/B/C on the frame top face, outside the S2 track.
3. Frame faces flat 0.02 and Ra ≤ 0.8 where S2 (top) and S3 (bottom) seal; weld must not reach the seal tracks (Ø40.5–43.5).
4. Every cassette: bubble point (ISO 4003, IPA) and clean-water flux at 0.2 bar; reject below 80 % of nominal.
5. In use the cake lies on the top face, 0.8 below the frame top: it can sit under a cover glass without being touched.
Disc media: A asymmetric sintered 316L: ~0.2 mm fine layer on 1.4 mm coarse support.
B symmetric sintered 316L powder, media grade 0.2, 1.6 mm (off-the-shelf disc).
C symmetric sintered 316L powder, media grade 0.5, 1.6 mm.
Flow model: Darcy with Mott KL; A uses 3× the permeability of a symmetric 1.5 mm
grade-0.2 disc (GKN quotes 'up to 4×' for its SIKA-R AS asymmetric media).
'Clean every' = litres of tap water until flow halves; assumes 0.5 mg/L solids, cake
resistance 1e+13 m/kg and the prefilter taking 40 % of the mass. To be measured.
A gives grade-0.2 capture at grade-0.5 flow: that is why it is the default.
